description: v2 of the crypto odds bot, rebuilt after v1 lost 33% in a day. Fixes: (1) correct settlement math: hourly markets settle on Binance's 1-hour candle close vs open, the others effectively on the end price vs the start price (verified against official outcomes), (2) Binance prices instead of Coinbase, (3) the market's own odds anchor the estimate and big disagreements are treated as model error, (4) no chasing favorites: only buys between 30c and 75c, (5) small, fixed, de-correlated bets, (6) loss limits checked every run, (7) only the two deepest markets (BTC, ETH).

model.note: P(Up) = Phi(ln(S_t/S_open) / (sigma * sqrt(minutes_left))), with the threshold shifted 10 bps against each trade. The estimate used for trading is halfway between this and the market's mid price; if the model and the market differ by more than 20 points, the bot skips (model error is the likelier explanation).

entry.note: edge = anchored probability - (ask + taker fee). No favorites above 75c: one loss there wipes out several wins.

sizing.note: fixed 3% of equity per bet; BTC and ETH move together, so at most one bet per settlement time and direction

risk.note: checked on every run: a 20% drawdown from peak stops new bets for the rest of the experiment; a 6% loss within one New York calendar day stops new bets until the next day
